<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="items" expr="[1, 2]"/><data id="total" expr="0"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <if cond="">
        <log expr="'yes'"/>
      <elseif cond=""/>
        <log expr="'maybe'"/>
      </if>
      <foreach array="" item="">
        <log expr="'each'"/>
      </foreach>
      <assign location="" expr="1"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: `cond` must name the condition of this branch

notes: `cond` is required on `<if>`; an empty value is no expression at all, so every time it runs it raises `error.execution` (SCXML 1.0 §5.9.4: the processor "MAY wait and place 'error.execution' in the internal event queue at runtime when the expressions are evaluated")
diagnostics.help: write the condition this `<if>` tests; a last branch that always runs is written as `<else/>`
